b_16_00.independence: Five passbands within one drift scan share astrometric calibration; do not count as independent years.
b_16_00.adoption: Other SDSS bands not yet approved: per-band centroid plus field WCS error propagation and held-source validation still required. Offsets describe local angular distances; no reuse of scalar RAERR as five independent errors.
